title: Add context.Context cancellation to a Go HTTP fetch helper
description: Brownfield Go refactor: add context.Context support to an HTTP fetch function so callers can cancel in-flight requests. The existing API signature must be updated to accept a context as the first argument.

required_artifacts: FetchURL signature changes to (ctx context.Context, url string)
Context cancellation propagates to the HTTP request
Original fetch behavior preserved for normal requests
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `go test ./...` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
